note: Illinois DNR park in the Apple River canyon in the hills of northwest Illinois. Canyon Ridge Campground sits on the wooded ridge above the river: grass back-in sites, water from spigots, restrooms and a dump station by the entrance. Loop 1 is first-come; Loop 2 is reservable. --Claude
